answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and scoped to the primary region during peak settlement writes, which matches the March regional-degradation pattern more closely than a fleet-wide release defect. memory_b2 says failover restored latency quickly with a clean traffic shift, which protects availability without intentionally dropping writes. Rollback (memory_b1) remains plausible given the 2-hour-old release, so those two archives should be checked before commit. Circuit breaking would fail writes; read-replica routing does not take settlement writes; extra capacity is secondary to a region-scoped fault. Peak settlement means a full cutover could perturb downstream settlement value, so keep the shift measured and do not treat cause as certain.
